scope: Transfer of source-native exclusions only; no new solver, compiler, proof replay, software test, witness, or global bound. UNKNOWN and TIME_LIMIT are never exclusion evidence.
small_id_rule: Within each width w: id=a*(w-1)+c-(144-w), with a=0..6, c=144-w..142, intervals [a,a+w],[c,c+w].
cover_relation: A<=a and a+w<=A+44 and C<=c and c+w<=C+44, with source status STATIC_EXCLUDED or INFEASIBLE.
